target.name: Macquarie Global Infrastructure Total Return Fund Inc.

announcement.quote: The Board of Trustees of each of the Acquiring Funds, listed below, announces the proposed reorganization of several closed-end investment companies advised by one or more affiliates of Delaware Management Company into the respective Acquiring Funds (“Reorganizations”).

deals.notes: The N-14 (0001104659-22-089428) states the special meeting of MGU was set for November 9, 2022 to vote on its reorganization into abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund. The later DEFA14A filings (to 2022-11-16) are shown only by their headers and a press-release label, so no result is in the excerpts.

target.name: Macquarie/First Trust Global Infrastructure/Utilities Dividend & Income Fund

announcement.quote: abrdn enters agreement to acquire the assets of four closed-end funds from First Trust Advisors L.P.

deals.notes: Pairing of this target with ASGI comes only from the FILING header (subject company CIK 1276469, filed by ASGI); the excerpted text lists three acquirers and four acquired funds without showing which target goes to which. Meeting was targeted for February 2024; no outcome in the excerpts.

problems: The 2023 press release names four First Trust target funds (Macquarie/First Trust Global Infrastructure/Utilities Dividend & Income Fund, First Trust High Income Long/Short Fund, First Trust/abrdn Global Opportunity Income Fund, First Trust Specialty Finance and Financial Opportunities Fund) against three acquirers; the excerpted text does not pair them, so only the one pairing supported by a FILING header is recorded. No outcome stated for any deal.
